data.disagreement_analysis: The 'inconclusive' verdicts were caused by tool errors: the qwen model encountered an HTTP 400 error when auditing .SRCINFO, and the openrouter model (advisory) failed to parse the LLM response for the PKGBUILD. The deepseek model successfully audited all files and found them safe.

learnings: Transient API errors or parse failures on non-executable metadata files (like .SRCINFO) should not force an overall 'inconclusive' verdict if the executable PKGBUILD was successfully audited and found safe.
